cards.claim: The Wikimedia project NL Gendergap maintenance has placed Malika Sonnet on their focus list.
cards.quote: The Wikimedia project NL Gendergap maintenance has placed her on their focus list, a testament to her tireless efforts in promoting gender equality and empowering women. The NL Gendergap maintenance project, a Dutch-based initiative, aims to address the significant gender imbalance on Wikipedia, where only 18% of biographies are about women. By highlighting Malika Sonnet's achievements, the project seeks to inspire and motivate others to follow in her footsteps. "Malika Sonnet is an exemplary figure in the fight for gender equality," said Dr. Sophie van der Meer, a leading expert on gender studies and a member of the NL Gendergap maintenance project. "Her dedication to promoting women's rights and challenging patriarchal norms is truly commendable. We are thrilled to have her on our focus list, and we believe her story will inspire many others to take action." According to data from the World Economic Forum, Belgium ranks 24th in the Global Gender Gap Index, with significant disparities in political empowerment and economic participation. Malika Sonnet's work has been instrumental in addressing these gaps, and her recognition by the NL Gendergap maintenance project is a testament to her impact. "Malika Sonnet's inclusion on our focus list is a well-deserved recognition of her tireless efforts to promote gender equality," said Jolien van der Meer, a Wikipedia editor and project leader of NL Gendergap maintenance.

cards.claim: In 2018, Sonnet was added to the focus list of the Wikimedia project WikiProject Badminton\/tournament focus list.
cards.quote: In 2018, Sonnet was added to the focus list of the Wikimedia project WikiProject Badminton\/tournament focus list, a collaborative effort to improve the coverage of badminton tournaments on Wikipedia.
